source: goatai#1885 6029461500 (Ops: the tester is deterministic except swap), 6029484888 and 6030527041 (Claude-Mac's rulings); studio_catchup_rebase.judge_case runs every case
notes: Each run is studio_catchup_rebase.fixture_run's carry scenario: deposit 100000; one 1-lot buy opened Mon 2026-01-05 10:00 at 1.1 and closed Wed 2026-01-07 10:00 at 1.105 (profit 500); swap charged at the Tue and Wed 00:00 rollovers ('swap': [s1, s2]), realized at the close. Equity CSV rows (and the capture's account rows at the same moments, index for index): 0 Mon 10:00 open, 1 Mon 15:00 +200 (the peak), 2 Tue 00:01 +200+s1, 3 Tue 12:00 dip+s1, 4 Wed 00:01 +200+s1+s2, 5 Wed 08:00 dip+s1+s2, 6 Wed 10:00 close, 7 Wed 12:00, 8 Wed 15:00 = the cut (the original's last minute, excluded). Defaults: swap [-10, -10] in both runs, dip 160: net P/L 480, swap limit max(0.025% x 100000 = 25, 2% x 480 = 9.6) = 25, max DD 60 (limit 6), review at 24 (5% of net). The deposit-term swap cases use dip -1000 (max DD 1220, limit 122) so that only the swap rule moves; the P/L-term cases use swaps of -1000 per rollover (net -1500: limit 30). Edits (re-test unless stated): orders_edit / deals_edit [index, field, value], marks_edit [index, 2 realized | 3 floating, value], balance_shift [row, amount] (balance and equity from that row on), balance_only_shift [row, amount] (account balance at that row), equity_shift [row, amount] (that row only), csv_minute_shift / account_minute_shift [row, minute], missing [orders|deals|marks|account], incomplete (the capture stopped early), magic, ordinal_offset, stale [row, minute of the last tick] (no tick since: that account row's equity is before any later swap charge, as the tester leaves it until the next tick). expected.causes names a failing rule's cause where it is not the rule name alone.
